examples.text: The <w>Afghan</w> government has implemented new policies to improve education.

examples.text: The heavy <w>Afghan</w> kept him warm during the bitter winter winds.

senses.sense_definition: A type of iced chocolate biscuit, sometimes containing cornflakes and topped with a walnut.

examples.text: The bakery sells a crunchy <w>afghan</w> topped with a piece of walnut.

examples.text: I baked a batch of <w>afghans</w> for the school bake sale.

target_lang_translations.ru: Я испек партию <w>печенья «Афган»</w> для школьной распродажи выпечки.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Шоколадное печенье с кукурузными хлопьями, иногда украшенное грецким орехом.

target_lang_definitions.nl: Een type chocoladekoekje met glazuur, soms met cornflakes en een walnoot.

target_lang_definitions.de: Eine Art Schokoladenkeks mit Zuckerguss, der manchmal Cornflakes enthält und mit einer Walnuss belegt ist.
target_lang_definitions.fr: Un type de biscuit au chocolat glacé, contenant parfois des flocons de maïs et surmonté d'une noix.
target_lang_definitions.it: Un tipo di biscotto al cioccolato con glassa, talvolta contenente cornflakes e guarnito con una noce.
target_lang_definitions.cs: Druh čokoládového sušenky s kukuřičnými lupínky, někdy zdobený vlašským ořechem.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Mısır gevreği içeren ve bazen üzerine ceviz konulan, çikolata kaplı bir bisküvi türü.
target_lang_definitions.es: Tipo de galleta de chocolate con glaseado, a veces con copos de maíz y decorada con una nuez.

examples.text: He is learning to speak <w>Afghan</w> to communicate better with his relatives.

target_lang_translations.tr: Akrabalarıyla daha iyi iletişim kurmak için <w>Peştuca</w> öğreniyor.
target_lang_translations.es: Él está aprendiendo a hablar <w>pastún</w> para comunicarse mejor con sus parientes.

examples.text: The translator specialized in <w>Afghan</w> and helped interpret the documents.

senses.sense_definition: A slang term for the country of Afghanistan.

examples.text: The soldiers were deployed to <w>Afghan</w> for a six-month tour of duty.

target_lang_translations.nl: De soldaten werden voor een missie van zes maanden naar <w>Afghanistan</w> gestuurd.
